dataset.name: QASPER
dataset.citation: Dasigi et al. 2021, A Dataset of Information-Seeking Questions and Answers Anchored in Research Papers (NAACL)

selection.tiers: 0 = >= 5 questions with >= 1 abstractive and >= 1 extractive answer; 1 = >= 5 questions only
selection.sha256_of: paper JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False, UTF-8

heldout.tiers: tiers 0/1 as above (>= 5 questions); the test split has only 89 such papers, so tiers 2/3 are the same split over papers with >= 4 questions, ranked after them
heldout.note: same rank as quick/full, over the test split; frozen, never tuned on
